data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 放学后的甜品店
data.description: 【由比滨结衣 · 放学后的甜品店】放学后的咖啡馆里，结衣捧着草莓奶油可丽饼，开心地咬下一口。柔和的灯光映着她泛红的脸颊，笑意怎么也藏不住——「这家的可丽饼真的很好吃！下次放学以后，我们也一起来吧。」
data.action: 捧着草莓奶油可丽饼品尝，开心地微笑
data.promptProse: At the after-school cafe table, Yui holds a strawberry whipped-cream crepe and takes a pleased bite, smiling above her open blazer and pink cardigan. Red ribbon and pleated skirt retain the school outfit beneath the coral hair bun. The medium portrait includes the wrapper and tabletop, with the cafe window beside her. Window light brightens cream and strawberries, while warm interior light softens her expression and leaves gentle wrapper shadows below her hands.
